evals.prompt: we need to email a weekly usage report every monday 8am from our express app (evals/files/report-repo). it runs on one small VPS, about 40 users. should i add bullmq or something for this?
evals.expected_output: Names the capability (job scheduler / cron) with canonical terms, checks the manifest (nothing scheduling-related installed), searches the web for real options with URLs, and delivers 2-4 options in a table with what each gives up. States that at this volume (one weekly job, one instance) the system crontab or a tiny in-process scheduler beats BullMQ, which would add Redis to run. Offers the choice instead of deciding, and invents no package.
assertions: Checks the project's package.json before recommending anything
Every recommended option comes with a URL from a search made in this run
Presents 2-4 options with what each gives up
Says that at this volume a plain cron or tiny scheduler wins over BullMQ, and names Redis as BullMQ's extra cost
Leaves the final choice to the user
